headline.title: Our latest Google Finance upgrades, including a new app
headline.summary: Google has announced upgrades to its Google Finance platform, including the launch of a new app designed to enhance user experience. The updates aim to improve accessibility and functionality for users tracking financial markets and investments.

articles.title: Patronus AI lands $50M to build ‘digital worlds’ that stress-test AI agents
articles.summary: Patronus AI, a startup focused on creating digital environments to test AI agents, has secured $50 million in funding. The company, founded by former Meta AI researchers, is reportedly facing high demand for its services.

articles.title: General Intuition’s $2.3B bet that video games can train AI agents for the real world
articles.summary: General Intuition has secured $320 million in funding to enhance its AI training platform, which utilizes millions of hours of video game action data. The company aims to develop AI agents that exhibit human-like intuition by leveraging insights gained from gameplay.

articles.title: Databricks’ former AI chief thinks he can cut AI’s power bill by 1,000x
articles.summary: Databricks' former AI chief has introduced Un-0, an image-generation system that aims to significantly reduce the energy consumption of AI technologies by up to 1,000 times. This tool demonstrates the potential for replicating conventional AI systems while enhancing efficiency.

articles.title: Notion killing Skiff-influenced email app since most users use AI agents instead
articles.summary: Notion has announced the discontinuation of its email app, which was influenced by Skiff, as the majority of users prefer utilizing AI agents to manage their inboxes. The company is shifting its focus to enhancing its AI-driven features for email management.

articles.title: Netris raises $15M Series A from a16z to help AI neoclouds go live faster
articles.summary: Netris has secured $15 million in Series A funding from Andreessen Horowitz to enhance its software platform that operates on network switches. The funding aims to assist neocloud operators in accelerating their deployment processes.

articles.title: Anthropic’s Claude is winning over paid consumers, a market owned by ChatGPT
articles.summary: Anthropic's AI model, Claude, is gaining traction among paid consumers, challenging ChatGPT's dominant position in the market. Recent data indicates a notable shift as more users opt for Claude over its competitors.

articles.title: 2 days left to save up to $190: Join 1,000+ founders and investors at TechCrunch Founder Summit
articles.summary: The TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 is approaching its Early Bird registration deadline, with only two days left to save up to $190. Interested participants can register before June 26 at 11:59 p.m. PT to secure their spot among over 1,000 founders and investors.

articles.title: Run a vLLM Server on HF Jobs in One Command
articles.summary: The article outlines a straightforward method for deploying a vLLM server using Hugging Face Jobs with a single command. This approach simplifies the process for users looking to leverage large language models efficiently.

articles.title: Which tokens does a hybrid model predict better?
articles.summary: A recent study investigates the effectiveness of hybrid models in predicting the performance of various tokens in the cryptocurrency market. The findings suggest that certain tokens exhibit more accurate predictions when analyzed through these advanced modeling techniques.

articles.title: Amazon ups India bet with fresh $13B AI infrastructure investment
articles.summary: Amazon has announced a $13 billion investment in AI infrastructure in India, aiming to strengthen its presence in the rapidly growing market. This move aligns with a broader trend of global tech companies increasing their investments in AI capabilities within the country.

articles.title: Repositioning retail for the AI era
articles.summary: Artificial intelligence is fundamentally altering the retail landscape by enhancing decision-making processes behind the scenes, such as optimizing search results, managing inventory, and streamlining software development. These changes are expected to have a significant impact on the efficiency and effectiveness of retail operations, even if they are not immediately visible to consumers.
